thread:
Maria Chen: heads up — on canary 3.4.1 we're seeing a spike in WS client reconnects that show as 'idle disconnect' in the console but traces show an outbound FIN from proxy first.
Ash Patel: I noticed the same in staging, looks like the proxy TTL is slightly shorter than the client's ping interval.
Kevin R.: can you paste the telemetry ids? I want to correlate with the congestion/retry metric.
Maria Chen: session_id=svc-0a7f, trace=8f3b2c. In the dashboard the 'idle_disconnects' counter jumped x4 at 03:12UTC.
Lucy (PM): does this map to billing spikes? Customers saw duplicate token counts last week.
Maria Chen: unsure yet, early signal only. But the route weight change we rolled out yesterday might have pushed more sessions through edge-a, which sits behind an older proxy pool.
Ash Patel: repro steps: run the interop client with keepalive=20s, server sends keepalive every 25s. Works fine for normal loads but under proxy GC the proxy sends RST on 15s idle.
Maria Chen: config snippet from client we used:
```js
const ws = new WebSocket(url, {
  handshakeTimeout: 10000,
  pingInterval: 20000, // ms
  maxReconnects: 5
});
```
Kevin R.: ok that explains misaligned timers. Two problems here: (1) proxy TTL < client pingInterval -> false idle, (2) console metric uses last-packet timestamp from client without proxy annotation so it blames client.
Ash Patel: +1. The metric is ambiguous. dash-bot, do we tag disconnects with proxy_node in traces?
dash-bot: metric metadata: disconnect_event includes labels [route, region, client_version]. proxy_node label not currently emitted for idle_disconnect.
Kevin R.: we should instrument proxy_node and 'close_initiator' (client|proxy|server). Small change in edge agent.
Lucy (PM): from UX perspective, can the console show a 'likely cause' hint if proxy closes >40% of disconnects for a route? That would reduce paging.
Maria Chen: yes, we can add a heuristic: if close_initiator=proxy for >30% in a 10m window show "proxy-initiated idle" with link to affected edges.
Ash Patel: also consider routing fix: revert yesterday's weight bump to edge-a while we patch agent. That will reduce noise.
Kevin R.: ops-bot, can we rollback route weight for tenant-tier=beta -> edge-a from 0.6 to 0.3?
ops-bot: rollback queued: route-adjust tenant-tier=beta edge-a weight=0.3; ETA ~2m. :gear:
Maria Chen: thanks. I'll push a tiny agent change to emit proxy_node and close_initiator tags. Patch diff in staging: add header propagation of X-Edge-Id and set close_reason on socket close.
Ash Patel: note for rollout — we must not emit X-Edge-Id for private deployments unless allowed by policy. Add opt-in flag.
Kevin R.: agree. Also let's add an alert rule: if proxy-initiated disconnects >20% and reconnect rate >100/min fire pager.
Lucy (PM): good. Also can we add a console tooltip explaining "idle_disconnect" vs "active_close" — customers keep assuming it's their SDK.
Maria Chen: I'll draft tooltip copy. Short idea: "Idle disconnects usually indicate an intermediary closed the connection due to inactivity or resource constraints. Check proxy_node label and recent route changes."
Ash Patel: quick grep to find affected proxies:
```bash
# find disconnects where close_initiator=proxy
grep -R "close_initiator=proxy" /var/log/edges/* | sed -n '1,200p'
```
Kevin R.: thanks — I'll correlate with the billing spike query tomorrow. For now rollback + agent tags should help.
Maria Chen: FYI I'm going to run a small canary (5%) with the tag change then flip full rollout if telemetry looks good.
Lucy (PM): keep me posted, no surprises to customers. :thumbsup:
Maria Chen: will do.
ops-bot: deploy canary 7391234567-tag-proxy-meta -> edge-a (5%) succeeded.
Maria Chen: initial canary shows proxy_node=px-12 on most recent closes, close_initiator=proxy. Dash now surfaces the label in the event details.
Ash Patel: great, console change looks useful. Closing this thread once we confirm billing unaffected.
Kevin R.: leaving a follow-up ticket to add proxy_node to long-term retention for 90d.
Maria Chen: created ticket INF-9241. Link: https://internal/redwood/INF-9241
Lucy (PM): thanks team.
